problem.title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree, return its level order traversal. The direction of traversal alternates at every level: Left to right for the first level. Right to left for the second level. Continue alternating thereafter.
problem.input: The root of a binary tree.
problem.output: A list of levels in zigzag order.
problem.constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 2000]
